requirements: Every touch reaction needs anticipation, response, hold, and recovery phases.
At least one secondary element should move for intimate or startled reactions: hair, sleeve, skirt, gaze, or hand overlay.
Looping idle/listen/speak motions must remain subtle enough for long desktop use.

requiredRuntimeBlend: Motion template provides jaw rhythm and mouth-form bias only.
Speaking state should blend with Listen/Idle without snapping head angle.

touchReview.runtimeBoundary: Persona may write the line; runtime owns zone permission, expression, cooldown, and motion allowlist.

turnReview.requirement: Use as a front-view 2.5D turn hint only until front/profile/back source packages and orientation-specific hit maps exist.

qaRepresentatives.reason: Voice adaptation and mouth parameter proof.
Future turn boundary and current preview behavior.

approvalGates.detail: Every Cubism motion template maps to at least one GitHub-backed reference family.
Speech has mouth-open and mouth-form curves for TTS/lip-sync handoff.
Every hot zone carries a semantic motion intent.
Private/sensitive zones stay runtime gated; model replies cannot bypass policy.
GitHub repos are references only, not asset sources.
TurnPreview remains a preview until multiview source packages exist.

nextRequiredEvidence: Cubism Editor playback capture showing each representative motion is visually distinct and not stiff.
Human review of shoulder, wrist, thigh, skirt, and chest reactions for natural timing.
Voice/TTS capture with ParamMouthOpenY driven by real audio and motion blending.
Profile/back source packages before any true turn or pose rotation claim.
